chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: The Viper Society and Basie's own privacy
summary: Asked whether he belonged to the Viper Society, Basie says few people ever saw him do anything and he kept it private.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did you ever belong to that Viper Society, I mean, was there a part for you in those towns when you were out?
Was there a part for you, you know, the Viper Society?
No, very few people I've ever known (inaudible) do anything.
Ever seen them -- see me do anything.
